name: trestle-webcomponent
description: Builds trestle-webcomponent.mjs: a <trestle-view> custom element wrapping @open-lakehouse/trestle-diagram, with React bundled in, for blog sites that have no React 19 (unitycatalog.io's Astro site, openlakehouse.io's React 18 app). emit.mjs runs the build when a post has a trestle diagram.
